name: tsugi
description: Show Copilot Chat context usage and hand off long conversations to a fresh chat in one click.

tsugi.saveHandoff.description: Save a copy of the handoff prompt to extension storage.

tsugi.warnPercent.description: Usage percentage at which the status bar changes to a warning color.

tsugi.baseOverheadTokens.description: Additional system and MCP overhead to add when Copilot's saved token details do not include it. Keep at 0 when the saved prompt total already includes tool definitions.
